Applying for a programme
How can I apply at the University of Vienna?
You would like to study at the University of Vienna? How you apply for admission and what requirements you need to fulfil depends, amongst other things, on your chosen degree programme.
Here you can find out how to start a bachelor’s, diploma or master's programme – from choosing the right programme, through deadlines and requirements, to submitting an application for admission to a degree programme. That way, you'll start your studies well informed.
Your steps to a bachelor's, diploma or master's programme
Step 1: Find your programme
Find your ideal degree programme! Each degree programme has its own page – the study profile.
There you can find out what the programme is about and what makes it special. You’ll also find a concise overview of deadlines, study places and the entrance exam or selection procedure, where applicable.
Find your programme!
Step 2: Keep an eye on the deadlines
The application period depends on two factors:
Is an entrance exam or selection procedure conducted in this degree programme?
Which citizenship do you have?
Check which deadlines apply to you straight away!
All deadlines
Step 3: Check the requirements
The study profile will take you to the admission info and, for master's programmes, to the Master Access Guide (MAG). There you can find out about the requirements, e.g.
the required documents,
the language proficiency and
the application period for the programme.
You've checked everything? Now all that's left is to apply!
Step 4: Applying well informed
All documents are prepared and the application period has started? Then you're ready to go!
Apply by submitting your application for admission to a degree programme via u:space, the University of Vienna's student portal. Make sure to upload all required documents in full.
We look forward to your application!
International students
You have completed school or university in another country and want to study at the University of Vienna? You have to bear several additional points in mind when applying – for example whether your documents need to be translated or legalised and what language skills you need.
Detailed info for international students

Other options
Non-degree programme
You want to attend individual courses but not complete a degree programme? A non-degree programme might be the right option for you!
Resumption of studies
You have studied at the University of Vienna in the past, discontinued your programme and now wish to resume it? Find out which steps you need to take next!
Co-registration
You study at another Austrian university and want to attend courses at the University of Vienna? This is how the co-registration works!
Studying without secondary-school leaving certificate
You don't have a secondary-school leaving certificate? The Studienberechtigungsprüfung is your path to studying!
You have further questions?
Admission Office
Anything unclear about the admission procedure?
Message us via our contact form or call us!
